Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 11

Rancorous Priesthood

Creature 11 uncommonGargantuanhumanhumanoidtroopunholy

Perception +21

Languages Chthonian, Common

Skills Athletics +22, Intimidation +21, Religion +22

Str +7, Dex +2, Con +6, Int +2, Wis +5, Cha +4

Form Up ◆ A troop squeezes back together into its full shape.

AC 31; Fort +23, Ref +17, Will +22

HP 195, thresholds 130 (3 segments), 65 (2 segments); Weaknesses area damage 10, splash damage 10

Troop Defenses Thresholds 130 (3 segments), 65 (2 segments)

A troop takes less from single attacks and shrinks as it loses Hit Points.

Speed 25 feet, troop movement

Divine Spontaneous Spells DC 30, attack +22; 5th (3 slots) divine immolation, shadow blast, noise blast; Cantrips (6th) daze, detect magic, divine lance

Cleric Domain Spells DC 30, attack +22, 2 Focus Points; 4th destructive aura; 1st cry of destruction

Troop Movement Whenever a troop moves, you move one of its segments and the other segments follow behind it. At the end of the movement, you can group the other segments adjacent to the one you moved as you see fit, provided none of them moves farther than the moving segment. If you choose not to move the troop any distance, you can instead reshape the position of all the segments as long as one stays in place.

Troop Spellcasting When the rancorous priesthood Casts a Spell, their constituent members combine their efforts into casting a more powerful version of the spell than any one member could achieve alone. When Casting a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

Wild Swing ◆ 1 to 3

Frequency once per round

Effect The members of the mob wildly swing their weapons in a chaotic attack at each enemy in a 5-foot emanation with a DC 25 basic Reflex save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d12+2 slashing damage

2 2d12+9 slashing damage

3 3d12+9 slashing damage
